verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships the Inso CLI, explicitly documented as designed for CI environments — it disables interactive prompts and returns exit codes to pass/fail builds, and supports test running, spec linting, and collection runs from CI/Git workflows without the GUI. This directly satisfies headless/automated execution for CI pipelines. Missing for 10: independent hands-on CI usage reports/case studies and more detail on advanced automation scenarios (e.g., parallelization, complex environment injection) beyond the docs themselves.
